Frequently Asked Questions

How long does delivery take?

Orders are dispatched within 1–3 business days of your payment being confirmed, and typically arrive in 7–15 days worldwide. Every order is tracked, and your tracking link arrives by email as soon as your parcel ships.

What payment methods can I use?

We accept USDT (Tether) on the BSC (BEP20) — BNB Smart Chain network. At checkout you see the exact USDT amount, our wallet address and a copy button before you place the order. After placing your order you have 24 hours to send the payment, then paste your transaction hash on the confirmation screen. Please send USDT on the BSC (BEP20) network only — USDT sent on any other network cannot reach us and would be lost. You only ever pay the total shown at checkout — there are no hidden fees.

What if my item arrives damaged or I change my mind?

You have 30 days. Email us at lumeora2@gmail.com with your order number for a replacement or refund — damaged items never need to be shipped back at your cost.

Why do prices show a discount?

The struck-through price is the regular retail price for the same specification. The Lumeora price is what you pay today, shipping calculated at checkout and free over $35.

Do you ship to my country?

We ship worldwide from our fulfilment partners — choose your country in the delivery form at checkout. If we ever cannot deliver to the address on your order, we will email you before you pay anything further.

How do I contact you?

Email us any time at lumeora2@gmail.com — please include your order number (LUM-XXXXXX) if your question is about an order.
